parties.respondent: The State of Tamil Nadu & Ors.

summary: Custody dispute involving children born out of wedlock; petitioner-mother sought habeas corpus for production and custody of minor children, alleging respondent-father unlawfully removed children to India in violation of U.S. court orders including a shared parenting plan and travel restrictions. Petitioner claimed respondent evaded U.S. custody arrangements, suppressed her contact information from the children, and threatened to relocate them to India without consent. Issues included enforcement of foreign custody orders, child welfare, and compliance with international parenting agreements.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 32 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Petition allowed in part; Court directed authorities to trace the children and ensure compliance with the U.S. court's shared parenting plan, emphasizing the best interest of the children and the need to prevent parental child abduction.
